direct CREATE PROCEDURE nums(k INTEGER, v INTEGER OUTPUT) BEGIN DECLARE i INTEGER; i = 1; WHILE i <= _k DO INSERT INTO __output VALUES (i * 10); i = i + 1; END WHILE; END

direct CREATE TRIGGER g5 ON src AFTER INSERT BEGIN DECLARE c CURSOR AS SELECT n FROM t WHERE n <= __new.n ORDER BY n; DECLARE x STRING; x = ''; OPEN c; WHILE FETCH c DO x = x + TRIM(CAST(c.n AS SQL_CHAR)) + ','; END WHILE; INSERT INTO log VALUES (2, x); END
